children: Li Ning's latest quarter update was better than anticipated, but the tone for 4Q remains weak, Deutsche Bank analyst Sammi Xu says in a note. Deeper discounts and lower average selling prices amid intensifying competition weighed on the running shoe market, while basketball, badminton and athleisure were also weak, the note says. While the overall channel mix improved in direct retail and e-commerce, total sell-through remained negative amid continued wholesale pressure. Deutsche Bank cuts its stock target price to 14.70 Hong Kong dollars from HK$15.20 with a hold rating. Shares are up 5.5% at HK$13.54. (venkat.pr@wsj.com)
